description: Resolves a UK company number, French SIREN, LEI, or a company name with country (GB or FR) to one company, and returns its identity, current signals (e.g. accounts overdue, insolvency notice, sanctions possible match for the company or its GLEIF direct and ultimate parents) and events of the last 90 days, each with its official source URL. A name that matches several companies returns error ambiguous_match with ranked candidates, each with its company number. Facts from official registers, never a score or a verdict; sanctions results are possible matches that need the user's own review. Cost: 1 lookup from the monthly quota (same as GET /v1/check). Price: 1 lookup at £0.02 per lookup (list unit price).

company.description: Registry number (e.g. 00445790, SIREN 552032534), LEI, or a company name

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (GB, FR); needed for name searches

name: sisoco_check_company

confidence.description: 1 for an exact identifier or name match

recent_events.description: Events in the last 90 days, newest first (max 20)

severity.description: Default severity of the type (profiles may change it from M5c)

vertical.description: Pack id for vertical events; null for the core product pack

signals.description: Conditions true now (e.g. accounts overdue, a sanctions possible match), newest first

sources.description: Where each core fact comes from, with a link to the official record. Signals and events carry their own source_url.

fields.description: Fields of entity this source backs, e.g. ["name","status","registry_id"]

source.description: The official source, e.g. Companies House

url.description: Link to the record at the source

watching.description: Whether this account watches the entity on any of its watchlists

title: Check a company
